description: This file defines a controller class for the 'topic' module extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying the topic configuration page and saving configuration data.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'topic' module extension in the admin interface, including methods to display and save the module's configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of the configuration page, setting up breadcrumb navigation, loading language strings, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the 'topic' module, including permission checks and returning JSON responses.
